notes.title: Updates to Daily Challenge Leader Board
notes.content:
I've revisited the way scores are stored on the server as described in [url=http://blog.gopherwoodstudios.com/2017/11/entanglement-leader-boards.html]this blog post[/url].

As such, the way the Daily Challenge leader board works has changed. Initially, it listed the past 7 days of scores. Now it lists today's scores, but also lists weekly and all-time scores.

Weekly and all-time scores are now based on a point system. At the end of each Daily Challenge, the day's scores are tabulated and all competing players from that day receive points according to where they placed on the day's leader board. The Daily Challenge Champion receives 50 points and other players in the top ten positions receive 10 points. Everyone else receives 1 point for participation.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30776250/82aafbed570b44d6537c969ab39dc9deaca3f0fc.png[/img]
[b]Lofty Prancing Llama has a [i]slight[/i] all-time lead.[/b]

When you become the Daily Challenge Champion or make the top ten, you should see a notification appear next time you play:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30776250/6539292ccf7b45700609803377633e3272e40505.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30776250/f817b013486242886970a16eb2c3fdfb6ff8a682.png[/img]
Enjoy!
- Derek D.
